children.value: > Fact From Story Tyreek Hill is on pace for multiple single-season receiving records and poised for his first Offensive Player of the Year award.
> > Fact From Story Tyreek Hill leads the league in receiving.
> > Fact From Story Six catches for 163 yards and a touchdown against Carolina left the Dolphins’ Tyreek Hill with 812 yards through the first six games.
> > > Fact From Story That ranks second in NFL history to Hall of Famer Don Hutson, who had 819 yards through six with Green Bay in 1942.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Being second in NFL history to a Hall of Famer is a sign of excellence.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Leading the league in receiving and getting many yards per game are signs of a good receiver.
> Commonsense Knowledge Wide receivers who are on pace for records and poised for awards are elite.
